title: Scaling to 1T MoE on TorchTitan [P]
summary: Hi everyone! Over the last few months we've been in the trenches with the TorchTitan and PyTorch maintainers, trying to find out how far GH200 (the GPUs inside the JUPITER supercomputer) can be pushed. Short answer: far enough to train a ~1T-parameter MoE at ~1,300 tokens/s per G
reason: Reddit experience report on scaling TorchTitan training to 1T MoE; no named model release with official owner link, no paper/benchmark artifact link, no new OSS tool announcement, and no business or policy event. No rule conditions met.
